answer: Based on the clinical guidelines from the ACC/AHA Hypertension Guideline (ACC/AHA, 2023), it is recommended that most adults with hypertension aim for a blood pressure target of <130/80 mmHg. The first-line agents in managing hypertension include thiazide diuretics, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, and calcium channel blockers. [ACC/AHA, 2023]

results.content: A blood pressure target of <130/80 mmHg is recommended for most adults with hypertension. First-line agents include thiazide diuretics, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, and calcium channel blockers.

Blood pressure measures the force of blood against artery walls, given as two numbers: systolic (pressure while the heart beats) over diastolic (pressure between beats). A normal reading is below 120/80 mmHg. High blood pressure often has no symptoms, which is why regular checks matter even when feeling fine.
results.citation: Understanding Blood Pressure Readings, MedlinePlus (U.S. National Library of Medicine), 2024
